name: zinput_bindmap_context_get_command_by_any_keyboard_key
description: zInput_BindMapContext::GetCommandByAnyKeyboardKey returns the primary-key command when present, otherwise falls back to the secondary-key command.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x470ae0 calls GetCommandByPrimaryKey first, returns that nonzero result immediately, and only calls GetCommandBySecondaryKey when the primary lookup returns zero.
Native smoke zinput_bindmap_context_smoke verifies both the primary-hit path and the secondary-key fallback path through direct context lookups.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x470ae0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zInput bind-map accessor pass.
